description: This file implements a Windows-specific dialog interface, including functions to create, display, and handle OK/Cancel dialogs at runtime using Win32 API. It defines a DialogTemplateBuilder class for constructing dialog templates dynamically and manages dialog callbacks and message handling.

classes.name: DialogTemplateBuilder
classes.description: A helper class to construct Windows dialog templates dynamically in memory.

methods.name: DialogProcedureCallback
methods.description: Callback function to handle dialog messages such as WM_INITDIALOG and WM_COMMAND.

methods.name: ShowOkCancelDialog
methods.description: Creates and displays a modal OK/Cancel dialog with specified callbacks and messages.

methods.name: DialogHandleMessage
methods.description: Processes Windows messages for the current dialog.

methods.name: CancelDialog
methods.description: Closes the current dialog if it is open.
